official_focus_document_set.aggregate_algorithm: sha256(sorted newline records: url byte_length raw_markdown_sha256)
official_focus_document_set.note: Ashby publishes Markdown-wrapped OpenAPI on each focus reference page. The pack omits a misleading openapi_source and retains every raw page and extracted contract hash here.

official_supplemental_guides.purpose: Basic API-key placement and version/media headers

official_inbound_webhooks.note: These pages describe requests Ashby sends to consumers and are not emitted as outbound operations.

transport.auth: HTTP Basic with the Ashby API key as username and an empty password; credentials remain connection-owned.

contract_gaps.split_openapi_fragments: Ashby exposes OpenAPI inside Markdown reference pages rather than as one directly fetchable raw OpenAPI artifact. Each admitted path is proved against its own focus page and hash.
contract_gaps.business_status: Ashby documents application failures that can return HTTP 200 with success:false. Its general response guide specifies errorInfo and optional warnings while the focus OpenAPI fragments specify errors arrays. REST bindings have no body-predicate failure hook, so response schemas preserve both official error shapes plus warnings, operation descriptions warn callers, and workflows surface each provider outcome instead of claiming status-only success is sufficient.
contract_gaps.inbound_webhooks: 28 inbound webhook pages describe Ashby-to-consumer traffic and are not callable outbound operations.
contract_gaps.partner_callbacks: 4 assessment endpoints are implemented by the partner and called by Ashby; they are directionally excluded.
contract_gaps.deprecated_aliases: 2 snake_case application aliases are excluded in favor of their documented camelCase replacements.
contract_gaps.response_only_pagination: Three list responses declare nextCursor/moreDataAvailable while their request contracts declare no cursor. The pack exposes one honest page and does not invent a replay parameter.
contract_gaps.empty_request_bodies: Six endpoints require an empty JSON object and declare no request properties; they expose required body_raw so callers can send {} rather than silently dispatching a bodyless POST.
contract_gaps.conditional_request_bodies: Two hiring-team mutations require exactly one of applicationId, jobId, or openingId in addition to their shared fields. They expose required body_raw so the provider-defined one-of invariant is not weakened by a flat argument map.
contract_gaps.optional_object_presence: Five non-paginated endpoints accept an empty or all-optional JSON object. They expose required body_raw so the adapter cannot silently turn an omitted argument set into a bodyless POST.
contract_gaps.alternative_identifier_presence: Four lookups or searches document alternative identifiers or filters while their embedded request schemas mark each field optional. They expose required body_raw because the composition request-schema subset cannot express a root union; this preserves every documented choice and guarantees a JSON body without choosing one filter as falsely mandatory.
contract_gaps.explicit_null_requests: Seven mutations explicitly document top-level null as clear, unset, or reset behavior. They expose required body_raw because the connection adapter omits null-valued body.* arguments; raw JSON preserves those vendor-defined state transitions.
contract_gaps.provider_permissions_vs_effect_risk: Ashby grants report.generate with reportsRead, but starting it creates and rate-limits an asynchronous report-generation job. The pack conservatively classifies that endpoint as a non-idempotent write while report.synchronous remains a read.
contract_gaps.complex_request_schemas: Scalar argument maps are closed. Array/object request maps retain an explicit operation arg allowlist but remain schema-open because the composition validator does not support closed complex property maps.
contract_gaps.source_eligibility: Ashby Project list/read contracts have mandatory identity but no mandatory version signal. Jobs and openings have version-like fields but are not relabeled as projects merely to fit Recued's closed Source kinds.

source_eligibility.note: Ashby Project is the only contract whose entity semantics match Recued project.
A recruiting job is not an Ashby Project and is not relabeled merely because its schema has id and updatedAt.
A requisition opening is not an Ashby Project and is not relabeled to satisfy the closed Source-kind set.
